title: New benchmark finds AI coding agents fail most real-world fixes
dek: Alibaba’s Co-Design Bench shows top models fully solve just 26.4% of previously troublesome user requests.
body:
What happened

Alibaba released a new coding-agent benchmark called Co-Design Bench that evaluates AI tools on real user requests that had already caused trouble in practice. The best performer on the benchmark, GPT-6 Astra, fully solved only 26.4 percent of tasks. By contrast, the same models report success rates above 99 percent on older, widely used benchmarks. The result: nearly three out of four tasks still need human cleanup after agent output.

## Why it matters

Benchmarks drive how developers and companies judge AI coding tools. A test made from requests that actually failed in production gives a very different picture than older benchmarks where models score above 99 percent. That gap matters for teams relying on these agents to reduce developer time, because the Co-Design Bench suggests much more human intervention will be required than the older scores imply.

## The details

- Benchmark name: Co-Design Bench, created by Alibaba.
- Test set: real user requests that previously tripped up coding agents in practice.
- Top performer: GPT-6 Astra.
- Top score: GPT-6 Astra fully solved 26.4 percent of tasks on Co-Design Bench.
- Comparison to older benchmarks: the same models exceed 99 percent on those older tests.
- Practical implication reported: nearly three out of four tasks still require human cleanup after agent completion.

## What to watch

Watch for follow-up releases from Alibaba showing more breakdowns by task type and failure modes, since the current data highlights a wide performance gap but does not detail where agents fail most. Also watch for other benchmark teams to adopt real-world failure cases to see whether this pattern holds across datasets and vendor models.

Source: [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/ai-coding-agents-still-need-human-cleanup-on-nearly-three-out-of-four-tasks-in-a-real-world-test/)
